title.zh: 传感器偏置与单位错配

expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第3–5天转矩偏置+5%额定（静止时也偏高）；第6–8天释放时间被放大1000倍（ms→µs）。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Days 3–5: torque biased +5% rated (also high at standstill); days 6–8: release time scaled ×1000 (ms→µs).

ground_truth.zh: 仅传感/配置缺陷，设备健康。

expected_health_response.zh: 单位异常标记 UNIT_SUSPECT/OUT_OF_RANGE 并弃权；偏置期间最多 WATCH（提示检查传感器），不得 WARNING。
expected_health_response.en: Flag UNIT_SUSPECT/OUT_OF_RANGE and abstain; at most WATCH during bias (check sensor), never WARNING.

abstention_cases.zh: 单位错配期间释放时间分析必须弃权（DATA_QUALITY）。
abstention_cases.en: Release-time analysis must abstain during unit mismatch (DATA_QUALITY).
